text: 今年38了，那就是40左右吧。
en: I'm 38 this year, so that's around 40, I suppose.

text: 体会就是，时间怎么这么快，就38岁了啊，这个数字有点恐怖，照镜子感觉自己有点难看了，可内心还很幼稚啊，毕业以后这十几年是怎么过的啊，什么也没干，一点波澜壮阔的事儿都没有。
en: The feeling is, how has time passed so fast—I'm already 38, this number is a bit terrifying; looking in the mirror I feel I've got a bit uglier, yet inside I'm still quite childish. How have these ten-odd years since graduation gone by? I've done nothing, not a single earth-shattering thing.

text: 女儿长大了，读初中了，可以自己去上学了。
en: My daughter has grown up; she's at junior secondary now and can go to school by herself.

text: 还能照顾我，去游乐园，她还安慰我鼓励我…
en: She can even look after me, go to the amusement park, and she comforts and encourages me…

text: ，老公白头发好多哦，他有点粘我，可是又好像不爱我，好没有意思哦。
en: ，my husband has so many white hairs; he's a bit clingy with me, yet it seems he doesn't love me—how very dull.

text: 内心有点空虚，工作也有点无聊。
en: I feel a little empty inside, and work is a bit boring too.

text: 以后还要一直这样过下去啊，那就快点退休吧，对退休还有点期待呢。
en: Will I have to go on living like this forever? Then let me retire soon—I'm actually a little looking forward to retirement.

text: 好无趣的生活…
en: What a dull life…

text: 人生最幸福的阶段，
en: The happiest stage of life,

text: 也可能是最沉重的阶段，
en: may also be the heaviest stage,

text: 减肥好难。
en: Losing weight is so hard.

text: 众所周知，减肥秘诀就是六个字：管住嘴迈开腿。
en: As everyone knows, the secret of losing weight is just six characters: keep your mouth shut and get your legs moving.

text: 曾有一段时间我尽量少摄入脂肪，每顿按时吃饭，主要吃的是纤维素含量高的蔬菜，如此坚持了一个多月，浑身没劲儿，上班干活没精神，连在家务都没有力气做，整个人又晕又软。
en: There was a time when I tried to take in as little fat as possible, ate every meal on time, and mainly ate vegetables high in fibre. I kept this up for over a month, but felt limp all over, had no energy for work, and couldn't even manage the housework; the whole of me was dizzy and weak.

text: 该不会生病了，我去看中医。
en: I couldn't have fallen ill, could I? I went to see a traditional Chinese medicine doctor.

text: 老中医量量血压，说我的血压偏低，交代我多吃点糖水鸡蛋，开了一些提升气血的中药，我一连吃了几副才慢慢恢复过来，原来我的身体已经适应了之前的营养供应。
en: The old practitioner took my blood pressure, said my blood pressure was on the low side, told me to eat more sugar-water eggs, and prescribed some Chinese medicine to boost my qi and blood. I took several doses in a row before slowly recovering. It turned out my body had already adapted to its previous nutritional intake.

text: 我有个同事坚持每顿吃得很少。
en: A colleague of mine insisted on eating very little at every meal.

text: 有一次她在公交车上突然两眼发黑，差点倒下去。
en: Once, on a bus, her vision suddenly went black and she nearly collapsed.

text: 同车老太太赶紧递给她一个包子，至今包子的味道依然在她的记忆中萦绕，她说从来没吃过那么好吃的包子。
en: An old lady on the same bus hurriedly handed her a steamed bun, and to this day the taste of that bun still lingers in her memory; she said she had never eaten such a delicious bun.

text: 后来我改换策略，不再拒绝吃肉，晚餐时只吃菜不吃主食。
en: Later I changed my approach: I no longer refused meat, and at dinner I only ate vegetables and skipped the staple food.

text: 如此坚持了两个星期，我的早餐较之前平时吃得多，而且特别容易出现低血糖，进而进食更多中午饭。
en: After persisting like this for two weeks, I ate a larger breakfast than usual, and was especially prone to low blood sugar, which in turn led me to eat more at lunch.

text: 如此一来，我又把头天下午没有吃的主食给补回去了。
en: In this way, I ended up making up for the staple food I had skipped the previous afternoon.

text: 我姐也尝试过，每天下午吃一个苹果，吃一点蔬菜，不吃饭。
en: My sister tried it too: every afternoon she ate an apple and a few vegetables, and skipped rice.

text: 她比我有毅力，坚持了三个月，体重依然保持原样。
en: She has more willpower than me; she kept it up for three months, yet her weight stayed exactly the same.

text: 管住嘴很难，改成迈开腿。
en: Keeping your mouth shut is hard, so I switched to moving my legs.

text: 我六点过醒过来，做好早点，叫醒孩子，我穿上运动衣到小区门口运动场。
en: I wake up just after six, make breakfast, wake the child, then put on my sportswear and head to the exercise ground at the entrance to the residential compound.

text: 虽然有疫情，运动场内依然活跃着各色人群。
en: Although there was the pandemic, all sorts of people were still active in the exercise ground.

text: 有人跑步，有人散步，有人兼具社交。
en: Some ran, some strolled, and some combined it with socialising.

text: 在塑胶跑道内圈，一群专业运动员保持整齐队列疾跑，最让我奇怪的是，他们每次超过我，他们居然还在闲谈，而且语气平缓，没有上气不接下气：“哎呦，我们今天跑了11公里。
en: On the inner lane of the rubber track, a group of professional athletes sprinted in a neat formation. What struck me most was that every time they overtook me, they were still chatting, and in a calm tone, without being the least bit out of breath: 'Ouch, we've run 11 kilometres today.

text: 我则不同，几圈下来跑得喉咙发干，气喘吁吁，说一句完整的话都很难。
en: I was different: after a few laps my throat was parched and I was panting, finding it hard even to say a complete sentence.

text: 不过，迎着晨曦奔跑，体验汗流浃背，这种感觉我喜欢。
en: Still, running towards the first light of dawn and experiencing a good sweat—I like that feeling.

text: 我坚持跑了快三年，身材还是老样子。
en: I kept running for nearly three years, yet my figure stayed just the same as ever.

text: 我一个朋友讲了她的减肥史。
en: A friend of mine told me her weight-loss history.

text: 她曾是一个运动员，退役后在体育训练基地做行政工作。
en: She used to be an athlete, and after retiring she did administrative work at a sports training base.

text: 虽然她身材匀称，一点都不胖了，她还是加入减肥大军。
en: Although she had a well-proportioned figure and was not at all fat, she still joined the army of dieters.

text: 她每天大概慢跑十多公里，一大早到训练基地先跑一个小时再上班，中午不睡午觉跑一个半小时。
en: She jogged more than ten kilometres a day, arriving at the training base early each morning to run for an hour before work, and at noon she skipped her nap to run for an hour and a half.

text: 她一连坚持了三个月，身上的肉一两没掉。
en: She kept at it for three whole months, yet not a single liang of flesh came off her body.

text: 想到这儿，我仔细观察运动场上奔跑人群。
en: Thinking of this, I observed the running crowd on the exercise ground carefully.

text: 不管是业余还是专业运动员，一般身材都不错，而且精神抖擞。
en: Whether amateur or professional athletes, they generally had good figures and were full of energy.

text: 我无奈成为运动人群中的胖子。
en: I helplessly became the fat one among the exercising crowd.

text: 看来，通过节食和运动达到减重这一目标遥不可及。
en: It seems the goal of losing weight through dieting and exercise is far out of reach.

text: 这种量化指标一旦在短期内无法达成，就容易让人丧失兴趣，没有信心，从而选择放弃。
en: Once such a quantitative target cannot be achieved in the short term, it easily makes people lose interest and confidence, and thus choose to give up.

text: 那就把目标调整为维持健康吧。
en: So let me adjust the goal to maintaining health.

text: 重新调整心态，不再要求长在身上多年的肉能快速消失于无形，也不再梦想能在有生之年瘦成一道闪电，只要没有三高，精气神尚可，活蹦乱就行了。
en: Readjusting my mindset, I no longer demand that the flesh which has grown on me for years vanish into thin air quickly, nor do I dream of slimming down to a streak of lightning in my lifetime; as long as I have no 'three highs', my spirit is still decent, and I'm lively and kicking, that is enough.

text: 在减肥路上，我应更注重享受过程。
en: On the road of weight loss, I should pay more attention to enjoying the process.

text: 多享受一下运动所带来的轻松和愉悦感，享受汗如雨下的畅快淋漓，享受吃清淡食物为肠胃带来通畅感和舒服感，不管未来结果如何，至少我们曾经快乐过，坚持过，尝试过。
en: Enjoy more the ease and pleasure that exercise brings, enjoy the sheer exhilaration of sweating like rain, enjoy the smoothness and comfort that eating light food brings to the stomach and intestines. Whatever the result in the future, at least we have been happy, have persevered, and have tried.

text: 朋友就像是水中的鱼，深水层和浅水层的鱼永远也不会走在一起;穷和富，官和民，草根和显贵都不可能成为真正的朋友，因为各自对人生的感悟不同，最关键是他们对待世界和自然的心不同。
en: Friends are like fish in water; fish from the deep layer and the shallow layer will never come together. The poor and the rich, officials and commoners, grassroots folk and the eminent can never become true friends, because their perceptions of life differ, and most crucially their hearts towards the world and nature are different.

text: 即使是富和富，官和官，显贵和显贵也不会成为真正的朋友。
en: Even the rich and the rich, officials and officials, the eminent and the eminent will not become true friends.

text: 因为有利益，有分别，有取舍，有轻重，有顾虑，能分出三六九等，尘世利益纷争之心蒙蔽了真情，因此，也不会有真正的情义。
en: Because there is interest, there is distinction, there is choice, there is prioritisation, there is concern; they can be ranked into grades high and low, and the worldly heart of contending interests blinds true feeling. Therefore, there can be no true affection either.

text: 若是你生命中至亲的人，父母健康，孩子阳光上进，你的另一半，是为平凡健康的人，自己健康，工作收入能够应付一家的开支，无车贷房贷，无外债，那就是人生赢家。
en: If the people closest to you in life—your parents are healthy, your child is cheerful and motivated, your other half is an ordinary, healthy person, you yourself are healthy, and your work income can cover the family's expenses, with no car loan or mortgage and no external debt—then you are a winner in life.

text: 如果你的至亲们，父母多病，孩子叛逆颓废，你的另一半是个多事精，且又各种作，就算你无外债，就算你身体健康，那也是一首悲壮的交响曲。
en: If your closest ones—your parents are often ill, your child is rebellious and decadent, your other half is a troublemaker who acts out in all sorts of ways—then even if you have no external debt and even if you are healthy, it is still a solemn and tragic symphony.

text: 要了你的半条命，是生不起，病不起，死不起。
en: It takes half your life: you cannot afford to live, cannot afford to fall ill, cannot afford to die.

text: 这几年疫情各行各业都不好过，不了解的人，可能觉得是在线教育行业的好机会，但我身处的公司（提供在线教育产品的技术公司）也不好过，其中的原因很多，太深入的咱作为最底层人士也不太知道。
en: In these past few years of the pandemic, all trades and professions have had a hard time. Those who don't understand might think it was a good opportunity for the online education industry, but the company I work for—a tech company providing online education products—is also struggling. There are many reasons for this, and as someone at the very bottom I don't really know the deeper ones.

text: 就算知道也没什么用，只知道各个互联网公司，包括大厂都在裁员，当然也包括我们这种不知名的IT企业。
en: Even if I knew, it wouldn't be of much use; I only know that various internet companies, including the big firms, are all cutting staff, and of course that includes small, unknown IT enterprises like ours.

text: 在去年的绩效考核中，HR就开始大幅缩减绩效A和B的员工，要求加大绩效C和D的，其实大家都懂，是在为裁员做铺垫，尽可能地让你得合理化。
en: In last year's performance appraisal, HR began drastically cutting back on employees with performance ratings A and B, and required boosting those with C and D. Actually everyone understands this was laying the groundwork for lay-offs, trying to make your rating as 'reasonable' as possible.

text: 任正非的一纸寒意，是真真正正地传递给了我们每一个人。
en: Zhengfei Ren's single sheet of chill truly reached every one of us.

text: 我们部门的业务线缩减，裁员比例要求上半年要达30%。
en: Our department's business lines were cut, and the lay-off ratio was required to reach 30% in the first half of the year.

text: 所幸，之前自己的表现一直可圈可点，连续拿了几年的优秀，每年绩效考核基本都是部门唯一的A。
en: Fortunately, my performance had always been commendable; I received excellent ratings for several years running, and in the annual performance appraisal I was basically the department's only A every year.

text: 所以，我自己也知道肯定不会被裁。
en: So I myself knew I definitely would not be laid off.

text: 但是眼看着身边共同奋战多年的同事一个个离开，内心更多的是一种“兔死狐悲”的凄凉感，而不是自己不在裁员名单的侥幸。
en: But watching colleagues who had fought alongside me for years leave one by one, what I felt more was a desolate sense of 'the rabbit dies and the fox mourns' rather than relief at not being on the lay-off list.

text: 业务的缩减带来的效果也不会是立马呈现的，我们在今年上半年，甚至在国庆之前，都还处于忙忙碌碌，每天的工作量过于饱和的状态，但是国庆之后的这几天，明显感觉到了工作量的骤减，当然是各种因素导致的。
en: The effect of the business contraction did not appear immediately. In the first half of this year, even before National Day, we were still busy and rushed, with a daily workload that was overly saturated. But in the days after National Day we clearly felt a sharp drop in workload, of course caused by various factors.

text: 这种变化带来的就是恐慌。
en: What this change brought was panic.

text: 在裁员的大背景下，手里没活的同事内心就会感到异常恐慌。
en: Against the backdrop of lay-offs, colleagues with no work in hand feel an abnormal sense of panic.

text: 以前在公司蒸蒸日上的时候，每天手里的活忙不过来，任务列表层层加码，每个人都是能推则推，什么职场大忌啊，什么职场生存法则啊，那都是没有人care的，大家都心知肚明地在心里嘀咕：不是我的活我就是一点都不干，怎么地，你还能把我开了不成？
en: In the past, when the company was thriving, the work in hand was more than we could cope with every day, and the task list kept piling on layer after layer. Everyone pushed tasks away whenever they could. All that talk of career taboos or workplace survival rules—nobody cared. Everyone muttered knowingly in their hearts: if it's not my job I just won't do a thing of it; what of it—are you going to fire me or what?

text: 但是在当下，还真就能把你开了。
en: But right now, they really can fire you.

text: 于是，每个人都怕自己工作量不饱和，毕竟世人匆匆，只为了碎银几两，如果真是不缺这几两碎银子，谁又每天冒着各种风险挤地铁挤公交，风雨无阻地来看老板同事脸色呢？
en: So everyone is afraid their workload isn't saturated. After all, the world hurries by, all for a few pieces of broken silver; if one truly weren't short of those few pieces of silver, who would brave all sorts of risks every day, squeezing onto the metro and the bus, rain or shine, just to read the faces of bosses and colleagues?

text: 甚至部门的一位老大姐，都没几年就要退休的，之前一直是一种摆烂状态的，都开始感到恐慌，来问我要活干。
en: Even an older female colleague in the department, who had only a few years left before retirement and had always been in a state of just letting things slide, started to feel panicked and came to ask me for work.

text: 我说我自己都没活干呢。
en: I said I had no work to do myself.

text: 人到中年，上有老下有小，还有房贷大山，不能失业，不能躺平，我也在学习，在上课，在读书，想着在工作之余可以做点什么，老公一把年纪了每天晚上都在挑灯夜读地要考证，即使知道就算考下来了，可能也没有多大用处，但是万一呢？
en: Reaching middle age, with elderly parents above and young children below, and a mountain of mortgage debt, I cannot lose my job and cannot lie flat. I too am studying, taking classes, reading, thinking about what I might do in my spare time. My husband, at his advanced age, burns the midnight oil every night studying for a certificate; even though he knows that even if he passes it may not be of much use, what if it is?

text: 我们都是背井离乡的北漂一族，想给孩子力所能及的好的学习生活条件，让父母的晚年可以没有后顾之忧，所以我们就不能停下脚步。
en: We are all a tribe of northern drifters who have left our hometowns, wanting to give our children the best learning and living conditions we can manage, and to let our parents spend their later years free of worries, so we cannot stop.

text: 于是鼓起了勇气找领导聊了聊，表达了一下最近没什么活的意思，领导当下也只是糊弄几句，说你如此优秀的人，公司会考虑之类的，我知道，领导上面还有领导，他也做不了主，还得往上反映，终于最终给我反馈了说上面要给我考虑接手其他工作，吃了一颗定心丸的同时，也觉得有点怪怪的，不知道从什么时候开始，习惯了上班摸鱼的开始担心上班摸鱼时间太长？
en: So I plucked up the courage to have a chat with my leader, expressing that I'd had little work lately. The leader just fobbed me off with a few words at the time, saying something like the company would consider it for someone as excellent as me. I knew that above my leader there was another leader, and he couldn't make the decision himself; it still had to be reported upwards. Finally, after all that, I got feedback saying the higher-ups would consider handing me other work. While this was reassuring, I also found it a bit odd: when did it start that those of us used to slacking off at work began to worry that we'd been slacking off too long?

text: 这是正常的吗？
en: Is this normal?

text: 我也不知道，我只知道，我需要这份工作。
en: I don't know either; I only know that I need this job.

text: 仅此而已。
en: That is all.

text: 从今天开始，努力学习，努力读书吧，也许黑夜里的奋斗真的能成为未来点亮自己的一束光，也未可知。
en: Starting from today, study hard and read hard; perhaps the struggle in the dark night can truly become a beam of light illuminating myself in the future—who knows.

text: 但是就像经常鼓励娃的那样，也鼓励一下自己，人生没有白走的路，每一步都作数。
en: But just as I often encourage my kid, I encourage myself too: there is no road in life walked in vain; every step counts.
